merge_basis: Study 1479-0012 (Beamion BCGC-1) covers Breast Cancer and Gastric Cancer cohorts under a single protocol; no existing group matches this study number or asset+indication combination. G0012 is 1479-0017 (Beamion Breast-2, 2L BC only) and G0015 is 1479-0013 (Beamion Gastric-1, 2L GC only) — both are distinct studies with different numbers and scopes.
